positions.name: DeriveIdMissingHeadingTest
positions.frame: what must a derive-id pass demonstrate when it reproduces the missing-id (## heading, no id field) failure pattern from prod?
positions.why: src-1 sets the scenario — a deliberate reproduction of a known prod failure shape (## heading, no id field) — and src-2 states the required behavior once that scenario is live (must not crash; must produce a valid slug). Read together they describe one test case: the setup and its bar for correctness. The directional reads differ in register and affect (src-1 calm/technical description of a reproduction; src-2 activated/matter-of-fact directive with parallel 'must' clauses) but both anchor to the same failure pattern and the same derive-id mechanism, which is what holds them as one group rather than two unrelated remarks.
